Every figure `wdm plots` draws for the current diet, from the real record as of {{< meta bw.as_of >}}. They are regenerated, with the [presentation](weight-dynamics.html)'s numbers, by one script whenever new days are logged, so nothing here is drawn by hand. The [documentation](docs/reading-output.md) explains how to read each one.

## Weight and body composition

![Raw weigh-ins (gray), the smoothed trend, and its 95% band. The trend is what moved; the scatter around it is mostly water.](assets/wdm/trajectory.svg)

![Estimated fat and lean mass with their bands. Fat mass is weakly identified from a scale, so read its trend rather than its level.](assets/wdm/composition.svg)

## The plan

![Today's plan: prescribed intake by week (top), and the predicted scale weight and tissue mass (bottom). Only the first day is eaten; tomorrow it is replanned.](assets/wdm/plan.svg)

![Each day's prescription, from the plans log, against what was eaten.](assets/wdm/plan_vs_actual.svg)

## What the model has learned

![What the filter believed about each metabolic parameter, day by day, relative to its prior (dashed line), with a 90% band. A band as wide as it started has learned nothing.](assets/wdm/parameter_evolution.svg)

![Where each parameter ended up, relative to its prior.](assets/wdm/parameters.svg)

![The maintenance estimate as it evolved (90% band), against the logged intake.](assets/wdm/maintenance.svg)

## Diagnostics and inputs

![Standardized one-step-ahead innovations: an honest model's are centered on zero with a standard deviation near one and no pattern.](assets/wdm/innovations.svg)

![The raw log as entered: energy and exercise, macronutrients, fiber, sodium, and steps.](assets/wdm/intake_log.svg)
